sources.title: Qwen3.5 Fine-tuning Guide | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: You can now fine-tune Qwen3.5 model family (0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B, 27B, 35B‑A3B, 122B‑A10B) with Unsloth. Support includes both vision, text and RL fine-tuning.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning Qwen3: A Step-by-Step Guide | DataCamp
sources.snippet: Truly, Qwen-3 embodies the principles of open AI. In this tutorial, we have learned how to fine-tune the Qwen-3 model on a medical reasoning dataset using the Runpod platform. Remarkably, the entire process cost less than $3.
